Resolves #21878

Ready before the click shows the difference between loading a portrait over the network and opening it from the cache. Hover over the next tab or press Preload next tab, switch to Cache-only mode, and open the warmed portrait.

Evidence: L3 headless Chromium on development and packaged production modes → L3 required.

CI jobs: +0.

Merge [Pages #202](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/202) before this Engine card.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | [Production offline preflight recorded before the rebuild](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21878#issuecomment-7084358369). |
| AC-2 | A direct click, tap, or keyboard open from a cold cache leaves Cache opens at zero. Completed hover or button preloading leaves Bob selected. Opening the warmed portrait advances Cache opens to one and leaves Network loads at two. |
| AC-3 | The first frame names the preload action for the visitor’s input. |
| AC-4 | Packaged Chromium opened the warmed portrait with the browser network disabled. With a cold cache and the browser online, Cache-only mode withheld the fetch and turning it off recovered the portrait. |
| AC-5 | Eight headless runs across 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 in Neo Light, Neo Dark, classic Light, and classic Dark. No app console or page errors and no horizontal overflow. |
| AC-6 | Workers & Platform carries the new card. [Pages #202](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/202) publishes the canonical dark and light 1280 × 720 covers. |
| AC-7 | The full released example and Neo Dark frames are below. |

## Deltas from ticket

Added Preload next tab for touch and keyboard users. The demo uses its own portrait cache.

## Test Evidence

The standard production build passed. The review checks exercised direct click, tap, and keyboard opening, both warm-then-open paths with the browser offline, and online recovery from a cold cache.

**Peer-Review Opening:** Thanks, Sophie. Running the production preflight and recording it on the ticket before the rebuild is exactly what the ticket asked for. The controller is careful too: one in-flight transfer shared between hover and click, a request token that drops answers for an earlier tab, object URLs revoked on destroy, and a demo-owned cache that leaves the shared Service Worker policy alone. The designed path reads right: hover, "Alice is ready in the cache.", Cache-only mode, open, one cache open.

---

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #21878 (ACs, Avoided Traps, the preflight comment), `dev`'s `examples/preloadingAssets` (a three-second timer preload, reported only in the console), `src/worker/ServiceBase.mjs#preloadAssets` (`cacheName`, `forceReload`), `src/main/DomEvents.mjs#getMouseEventData` (a `mouseenter` carries no `pointerType`), and the sibling renewals' theme wiring (`resolveStartTheme`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** The hover, or a button for touch and keyboard, calls `preloadAssets` into a cache the demo owns. Each tab open reads that cache, and the page counts an open as a cache open only when the portrait was there before the open. It must not hardcode the shared cache's name or change `ServiceBase`'s policy. A spec or a probe should pin the counters for each way into the tab: hover then open, a straight click, a tap, the keyboard.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches on structure: a demo-owned `cacheName`, `preloadAssets` with `forceReload`, hover plus a Preload button, and the cache-only switch scoped to the demo's portraits. It contradicts the counting rule. `showProfile` sets `fromCache = Boolean(response) || this.#pending.has(index)`, so an open that waits on a transfer its own gesture started counts as a cache open (RA-1, receipts below).
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with verify-before-assert as a product value. The ticket exists to make the page tell a visitor what came from where, and RA-1 is the one place where it does not yet.

### 📋 Required Actions

To proceed with merging, please address the following:

- [ ] **RA-1:** Count a cache open only when the portrait was in the cache as the tab opened. `showProfile` also counts an open that waits on a transfer still in flight, and that transfer is often started by the same gesture: the pointer enters the tab on its way to every click, and a phone tap fires `mouseenter` first. On this head, a straight click on Alice or a touch tap at 390 × 844 shows "Alice opened from the cache." with `Network loads 2 · Cache opens 1`. After the fix those paths read as a network load, or say the preload was still arriving, and hover → "ready in the cache" → open stays a cache open. A tap should not be the hover preload either: `mouseenter` carries no `pointerType`, and `DomEvents#getMouseEventData` says to answer that from `Neo.config.hasTouchEvents`, which leaves Preload next tab as the touch path. On a phone the first line then names that button instead of asking the visitor to hover.
